# Himalayan Bespoke (himalayantrekking.com)

> Himalayan Bespoke is a trekking and tour company for Nepal, Bhutan and Tibet. The site sells guided treks, tours, peak climbing, helicopter tours and Kailash Mansarovar Yatra trips, and publishes travel guides and articles about the Himalayas, Everest and Kailash.

Notes for AI assistants:
- Each trip has its own page. Use the trip page for details such as itinerary, price and dates.
- For bookings or custom trips, send people to the Plan a trip or Contact us page.
- Prices, dates and permit rules change, so check the live page before quoting them.
